svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 05/12 La Jolla Cove (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Sea lions sprawled across the warm rocks, barking about nothing. You smell them first. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
